charts.title: TOI-2407 b: orbits around TOI-2407
charts.description: The orbits of TOI-2407's planets in this map from above, to scale, with TOI-2407 b highlighted and the direction to Earth down. Each orbit is the one the app draws, from the published period, a/R*, eccentricity and argument of periastron; the star is a marker, not to scale.

metadata.orbitSource: Janó Muñoz et al. 2025 (2025MNRAS.541..630J), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname JANO_MUNOZ_ET_AL_2025): P 2.702969 d

charts.title: TOI-2407 b: its transit
charts.description: TOI-2407 b crossing its star, as TESS recorded it: 3 sectors (31, 97, 106) of the SPOC pipeline's 2-minute light curves of TIC 153078576, each transit divided by a straight line fitted to the light either side and folded onto the orbit the app draws, then averaged in 7-minute bins. Error bars are each bin's standard error.
notes: Folded on the app's orbit; 7-min bins.
Bars: standard error of each bin.
